posts.title_en: Tested conquest gear with 3 lines of resistance and 3 lines of move speed, each
posts.summary_en: Poster tried gear with 3 resistance (저항) lines and, separately, 3 move-speed lines. Neither helped: resistance did nothing, and move speed lined the cookies up oddly, so the cookies meant to survive the 17 s wipe died and the score dropped sharply. They are rerolling back to skill haste + DMG reduction (스가 피감).

gear.why: Tested: breaks the formation; 17 s survivors wiped; score fell
The setting the poster reverts to

mechanics: Move speed on gear changes where cookies line up; a 3-line move-speed build caused the 17 s survivors to die.

posts.title_kr: 토벌전 피냐타 분석 - 최종 수정 완 (10/7 01:27)
posts.summary_en: Datamined boss analysis by 삥삥. 60 s fight against an unkillable body (HP 4.6E); score = damage dealt to the body only (summon damage not counted). Body DEF 2000 → taken damage ×0.2; Dark, Light attackers ×1.15; crit resistance 0; immune to lift/knockback/control. Each 12 s spawner adds a self-buff about 10.5 s later that raises DMG reduction (0→10→30→50→70→90%) and multiplies body ATK (5K → 750M). Summons scale exponentially and cause the late wipe. Advice: front-load damage in 0–34 s.

gear.substats: crit rate / crit damage, ATK, skill amp, accuracy
gear.why: Body crit resistance 0; boss DMG / final DMG / element DMG are skill/buff stats, not gear options (author)

rng: Wipe time is not fixed; it depends on party survivability (author)
mechanics: Fight: GuildRaid_1, limit 60 s, bossHpMul 1.0, recommended power 100, accuracy multiplier ×10.0, other multipliers 1.0

Body (id 1976336819, mc0034, Dark): ATK 5,000, DEF 2,000, HP 4.6e18 (unkillable), speed 0, ACC 100,000 (×10 = 1M effective), AVO 100, crit/crit dmg/crit res 0, FOCUS 100, RESIST 100, lift resistance 1.0, knockback immune, actionImmune; hit radius 5.0, repulse 5.0, range/detect 100/100, targets EnemyWithMinDistance
Score per hit ≈ damage × defMul 0.2 (=1/(1+2000/500)) × element (Light ×1.15, else ×1.0, no disadvantage) × (1 − DMG reduction) × crit × (1+boss DMG) × (1+final DMG) × CP band
CP band = team power / recommended 100 ratio, penalty 0.01–1.2; below recommendation the score drops sharply

The phase buff is one modifier with two effects: DAMAGE_DECREASE_SCREEN (official 'DMG Reduction') and ATTACK_POINT_MULTIPLIER (mult = 1 + value/10000; 1000000 → ×101). Values bp 1000–9900. Author says 505,000 matches measurement

Boss skill = spawner_01~06 at cooldown 0/12/24/36/48/60 s; within each: +2.0 s gift_drop (radius 2, knockback 1, lift 0.6, 12.5% ATK); +4.0 s summons (centre, then left +0.3 s, right +0.3 s); +6.5 s projectile_wave (full-screen, knockback 5, lift 0.85, 100%); +10.2 s jump slam explosion_buff (radius 10 around nearest ally, knockback 10, lift 0.9, 100%); +10.5 s DMG-reduction buff applied

Summons (mc0035), DEF 100, crit 0.1 fixed, 3 per tier (centre/left/right), life 60 s, rush (2×2 AoE, knockback 5, lift 0.6) and bite (single, knockback 0.25): tier1 0 s ATK 1,667 / HP 6,668; tier2 12 s 168,333 / 673,332; tier3 24 s 8,335,000 / 33,340,000; tier4 36 s 41,668,333 / 166,673,332; tier5 48 s 83,335,000 / 333,340,000; tier6 60 s 250,001,667 / 1,000,006,668

Author: the late-fight wipe is mainly the summons' ATK explosion; ally HP drops sharply from 24 s (8M) and 36 s (41M) tiers. Note the text elsewhere also says body slam/wave damage scales with the ATK multiplier (internal inconsistency: one line says body direct hit stays 5,000)
Summon damage is not counted in the score; hit the body only
Tips: dump buffs/cooldowns/ultimates in 0–34 s (DMG reduction ≤50%); Light dealers; knockback/lift resistance and protective buffs (e.g. Chardonnay's holy-water wall 성수벽) to survive wave and slam
disagreements: Within the post: '[4] ... 본체 직격(슬램/파도 5,000)은 고정' contradicts '[3]/[5] 본체 공격력 5,000→505K→…→750M 폭증' for slam/wave damage
crumb.gg calculator (82457-2.jpg) shows a DEF factor of ×0.383 at boss DEF 2000, vs this post's defMul 0.2

quotes.kr: 60초 동안 '불사' 피냐타 본체에 누적 피해를 쌓는 콘텐츠 = 그 누적딜이 내 점수.
quotes.en: Content where you stack damage on an 'undying' piñata body for 60 s = that cumulative damage is your score.
Phases: body DMG reduction 0% (0–10 s) → 10 → 30 → 50 → 70 → 90% (at 0/10/22/34/46/58 s; 99% never applies)

quotes.kr: 속성  : 본체 어둠 → 빛 공격자 ×1.15 / 그 외 ×1.0 (열위 감소 없음)

quotes.en: Main cause of the late party wipe = these summons' ATK explosion (not the body's direct hit). Ally HP plunges from the 24 s (8M) and 36 s (41M) tiers.
